_comment: ADR-037 manifest fragment for marketing-search-intelligence (phase 5). Kept in its own file so the concurrent campaigns build does not conflict on the Marketing group. All three pages are path-routed: a deep link is /index.php/apps/pipelinq/marketing/keywords, never a hash route.

pages._note: Keyword proposals (marketing-search-intelligence). Custom rather than a declarative type:index over keywordTarget, because what this page shows is not a collection at all: it is four DERIVATIONS computed over the searchQueryDaily rows at read time (position buckets, striking distance, cannibalisation, content gaps), served by one GET /api/marketing/keyword-proposals. The keywordTarget objects it can create are the OUTPUT, not the input. Missing primitive: a page backed by a computed report with a per-row create action.
pages.title: Keywords

pages._note: Competitor watches and what they saw (marketing-search-intelligence). Custom rather than a declarative type:index over watchEvent, because the page has to join three schemas in one read (competitor, competitorWatch, watchEvent) and, more importantly, because a watch's LAST OUTCOME is what tells 'they published nothing' apart from 'we could not read it'. A plain event list would render both as an empty table. It also carries a per-watch run action, which the declarative grammar has no verb for.
pages.title: Competitors

pages._note: The follow audit (marketing-search-intelligence), board PqVerbindingscontrole: per client and network, whether we follow them and whether they follow us, and WHY an answer is unknown. A board-look index over the stored socialConnection rows: the reason is its own column, so the third answer (the network will not say) is never shown as a no. The verdict columns go through the `auditVerdict` formatter, which prints an empty or unknown verdict as Cannot be checked. Check again re-runs the audit through GET /api/marketing/connection-audit?refresh=true (`rerunConnectionAudit`); the rows it writes reach the page through the collection's live update.
pages.title: Connection audit
